newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil April unemployment down at 5.75 pct - IBGE.
newsitem.headline: Brazil April unemployment down at 5.75 pct - IBGE.

text.p: Brazil's April unemployment rate fell to 5.75 percent from 5.97 percent in March, the National Statistics Institute (IBGE) said.
The unemployment rate also fell in comparison with April 1996, when it stood at 6.03 percent, the IBGE said.
In the first four months of this year, the average unemployment rate dropped to 5.6 percent from 5.84 percent in the same period last year, the IBGE said.
The number of people working remained stable in April, while the number of people out of work fell 3.9 percent in the six main urban centers surveyed, the IBGE said.

The unemployment rate fell in four of the six urban areas, rose slightly in Salvador and remained unchanged in Belo Horizonte, the IBGE said. ((-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
